timing: Frame counts are initial design parameters, not measured balance. Use engine update frames; do not advance while paused or in dialogue.

KAZANE.name_ja: 空織りの番人 カザネ

states.action: Face the player; show three pale arrow lines. Capture aim at state entry; never retarget after the warning.
At frame 0 fire 3 cardinal/diagonal shots at speed 2. In phase 2 fire another 3 at frame 18; second fan uses the same captured direction. Avoid floating point.
Show a wide straight ribbon toward captured player foot position; capture target once.
Move up to 2 px/frame along the captured segment, clamped to move_bounds. Stop early at target. Cannot bend toward the player.
Stationary; wind-knot symbol blinks. Fuuri R within Manhattan 64 changes state to EXPOSED. Wrong power cannot remove the veil. Otherwise loop to AIM.

Clear hostile shots, stop contact damage for first 30 frames, hold position. Sword hits deal 1/2 for normal/third combo hit, with existing 18-frame boss hurt lock. Wind cannot extend this window; after timeout return to AIM.

KAZANE.phase_transition: At <=10 HP, finish the current exposure; subsequent loops use the second volley. Show an extra ribbon, not only a color change.
KAZANE.safety: South retreat always open; no pits, resource costs, summon losses, or combat adds. At least one full dodge-width lane remains clear in every volley.

phases.attack: Mark horizontal bands [16,96,208,12] then [16,120,208,12]. Each band warns 36 frames, hurts for 8, then disappears; a 24-frame gap separates bands. A band damages at most once per activation. Stone guard or dodge can block it.
Warn 36 frames, fire a 5-shot fan toward a captured direction at speed 2, wait 36 frames. Wind removes nearby hostile shots; do not create a projectile ring with no gap.

Warn two fixed vertical columns [56,44,16,92] and [168,44,16,92] for 36 frames, active for 10 frames, then clear. Center and side lanes remain safe. Next loop uses horizontal bands from phase 1 instead.

cycle.action: Run the phase attack, then enter RECOVER.

Required-power symbol and shell opening pulse. Required R within Manhattan 64 exposes core for 180 frames. Homura uses explicit boss-target ignition on R, not a projectile that can accidentally hit a prior phase. If missed, loop PATTERN.
No phase attacks; clear remaining hostile shots. Sword deals 1/2 as above. Clamp damage at HP 16 and HP 8 so one hit cannot skip a phase. Power casts cannot extend exposure.
Harmless pause, clear all hazards, display the next symbol and one-line hint, reset cooldown to 0. Do not take damage during the transition.

reward.after_dialogue: village elder spawn; ELDER_FINAL + ENDING_FRIENDS earns ENDING_SEEN

CLOSED_CORE.ending_resume: If power is interrupted after CORE_CLEAR, continue in the peaceful village; the elder still provides the ending. The core never respawns.
CLOSED_CORE.safety: All phases repeat indefinitely without spending resources. The bottom escape remains open. No need to tank damage, have the optional health relic, or execute a perfect three-hit chain.
